panels.description: To run this dashboard, start from Usage Stats, selecting the desired EAA_APP.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS d,
  uniq(username) as "Total_Username",
  uniq(origin) as "Total_Origin",
  uniq(apphost) as "Total_EAA_APPS",
  uniq(cloudZone) as "Total_cloudZone",
  SUM(bytesIn) "Incoming",
  SUM(bytesOut) "Outgoing",
  uniq(conUuid) as "Total_Connectors"
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND origin != '-'
  AND username != '-'
  AND apphost != '-'
  and conUuid != '-'
GROUP BY  d
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Users per APP; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Apps Observability

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    uniq(username) AS Total_Username,
    d
FROM (
    SELECT
        username,
        CASE
            WHEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE
             AND datetime <  now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
                THEN toStartOfMinute(now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
            WHEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 75 MINUTE
             AND datetime <  now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE
                THEN toStartOfMinute(now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE)
        END AS d
    FROM ${table}
    WHERE datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 75 MINUTE
      AND username != '-'
      AND apphost != '-'
      AND ${generalescaping}
      AND $__adHocFilter()
) t
WHERE d IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Connected users; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
    uniq(origin) AS Total_Origin,
    d
FROM (
    SELECT
        origin,
        CASE
            WHEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE
             AND datetime <  now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
                THEN toStartOfMinute(now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
            WHEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 75 MINUTE
             AND datetime <  now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE
                THEN toStartOfMinute(now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE)
        END AS d
    FROM ${table}
    WHERE datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 75 MINUTE
      AND origin != '-'
      AND apphost != '-'
      AND ${generalescaping}
      AND $__adHocFilter()
) t
WHERE d IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Origin used; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT sum(bytesIn)*8/60 as Incoming, sum(bytesOut)*8/60 AS Outgoing, 
toStartOfInterval(datetime, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS d
FROM ${table} 
WHERE datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
AND ${generalescaping}
AND $__adHocFilter()
AND apphost != '-'
AND username != '-'
GROUP BY d
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Bandwidth usage; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
  username, count() as Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND origin != '-'
GROUP BY username
ORDER BY Total DESC
LIMIT 5
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 5 username by hits; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
  cloudZone, count() as Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND origin != '-'
GROUP BY cloudZone
ORDER BY Total DESC
LIMIT 5
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 5 cloudzone by hits; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
  conUuid, count() as Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND origin != '-'
GROUP BY conUuid
ORDER BY Total DESC
LIMIT 5
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 5 connectors by hits; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS d,
  avg(originRespTime) as "Origin_Response_Time",
  avg(connectorRespTime) as "Connector_Response_Time",
  avg(totalRespTime) as "Total_Response_Time"
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND origin != '-'
  AND username != '-'
  AND apphost != '-'
  and conUuid != '-' 
  and totalRespTime is not null
  and connectorRespTime is not null
  and originRespTime is not null
GROUP BY  d --, connectorRespTime, originRespTime, totalRespTime
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Response time; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT geoCountrycode, geoCountry, uniq(username) as Total_users
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) 
AND ${generalescaping}
AND $__adHocFilter() 
AND apphost != '-'
AND username != '-'
GROUP BY geoCountrycode, geoCountry
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Recent user locations; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT apphost, origin,
       maxOrNull(datetime) AS Last_Access
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
AND ${generalescaping}
AND $__adHocFilter() 
AND origin != '-'
AND apphost != '-'
GROUP BY apphost, origin
ORDER BY Last_Access DESC
limit ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top ${querieslimit} origin to EAA_APP; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  arrayElement(splitByChar(':', ifNull(origin, '')), 2) AS port,
  count(port) AS port_count,
  maxOrNull(datetime) AS Last_Access
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND origin IS NOT NULL
  AND origin != '-'
GROUP BY port
ORDER BY port_count DESC
LIMIT ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top ${querieslimit} active ports; du=${__user.login}';

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS time,
    statusCode,
    count(*) AS "Total"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
GROUP BY time, statusCode
ORDER BY time ASC, statusCode
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Status codes; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS time,
    errorCode,
    count(*) AS "Total"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
GROUP BY time, errorCode
ORDER BY time ASC, errorCode
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Error codes; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
    sessionId,
    count(*) AS Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
  AND sessionId != '-'
GROUP BY  sessionId
ORDER BY Total desc
limit ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top ${querieslimit} session ID; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS time,
    httpMethod,
    count(*) AS "Total"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
GROUP BY time, httpMethod
ORDER BY time ASC, httpMethod
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=HTTP method; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT datetime, 
       origin,
       apphost,
       username, 
       clientip, 
       cloudZone, 
       geoCountry, 
       geoCity, 
       originRespTime, 
       totalRespTime, 
       errorCode,
       httpMethod,
       httpVerb2,
       idpinfo,
       referer,
       sessionId,
       sessionInfo,
       statusCode,
       urlPath,
       userAgent,

       IF(clientId != '-', 'tunnel', 'application') AS application_type, 
       clientId
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
AND ${generalescaping}
AND $__adHocFilter() 

AND apphost != '-'
-- AND origin != '-'
AND username != '-'


ORDER BY datetime DESC
LIMIT ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Last ${querieslimit} access logs; du=${__user.login}'
